what: A stitch-style dashed line (6 9) sews down the section’s left edge. It is tied to scroll (scrub 1.2) and drawn from when the section’s top edge hits 12% of the screen until its bottom edge hits 60%, and a needle (ellipse 2.5×4, shape kept even when the panel stretches) follows the thread end (hidden for the first 1% and last 6%). Once the needle passes the signature (sign) height, the signature is written from the left after .65s, over 2.2s with power1.inOut.
use: …
note: The thread board is an svg covering the whole section (preserveAspectRatio none), so it stretches to the section height — the user draws the thread length to fit the section shape. The signature (sign) is optional
